question: In symmetric encryption, how many keys are used to encrypt and decrypt data?
solution:
The correct answer is __**One Key**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

• Symmetric encryption uses a single key for both encryption and decryption of data.

• The key must be shared between the sender and the receiver to facilitate secure communication.

• Symmetric encryption is generally faster and less computationally intensive compared to asymmetric encryption.

• Common symmetric encryption algorithms include AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) and DES (Data Encryption Standard).
